system.description: This unit cannot become Grounded. It is always airborne.
Drains its victim of life force, healing the caster's HP by the same amount as the damage dealt.
A veil of ethereal blur. Physical weapons are almost useless against it.

The banshee's scream causes all who hear it to be paralyzed with despair. All adjacent units, friend or foe, must succeed a Cha saving throw (DC 14) or else take 1d10 + Wit Shadow damage, 6 Brk damage, and are Restrained for 1 turn.
The droppings of a spectral entity. Useful for alchemical or magical purposes.
